name: How do I know if a garage flooring installer is qualified?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if a garage flooring installer is qualified?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most important proof is a clear prep process: mechanical grinding, crack repair, dust control, and a written explanation of the coating system. Ask for photos of completed jobs, warranty details, and examples of floors that have held up for a few years. If the contractor cannot explain surface prep in detail, that is a warning sign.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for clear surface prep steps, warranty information, and real project photos. A qualified installer should explain how they grind, repair, and coat the floor.
